{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uChairsRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places chairs (bar supports) under a reinforcement mat. The leg and offset fields are measured to the outside of the bars, so a typed leg length is the length you get on the bar. Defaults: a B500B 12 bar with 50 mm covers. The tool passes its native suite (4053 checks) and an end-to-end insert and modify test on Tekla 2026.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uChairsRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uChairsRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
